gui.guhs.safari.guhziet.groot.2: %1$s: A %2$s! Can I ride it? No? Okay.

gui.guhs.safari.aussie.hangmat.0: Zzz... huh? Oh, g'day mate! Nothing going on, I'm testing this hammock. For three weeks now. Beauty of a hammock.
gui.guhs.safari.aussie.hangmat.1: No worries, mate. Koalas sleep twenty hours a day. I do twenty-one. I win.
gui.guhs.safari.aussie.hangmat.2: Strewth, is it noon already? Wake me when the kangaroos do something exciting. Zzz...
gui.guhs.safari.aussie.post.0: G'day! Sending a postcard? No worries, mate. The last one never arrived, by the way... it must still be lying around here somewhere.
gui.guhs.safari.aussie.post.1: Mail for the wombats? Nah, they just dig a tunnel to the neighbours. Easy as.
gui.guhs.safari.aussie.post.2: Quiet day, mate. It's always a quiet day. Fair dinkum.
gui.guhs.safari.aussie.kamp.0: G'day! Have a seat by the fire. In the evening the wombats potter about here, if you're quiet.
gui.guhs.safari.aussie.kamp.1: Know what a billabong is, mate? A little pond where the kangaroos come to drink. Over there by the windmill!
gui.guhs.safari.aussie.kamp.2: Crikey, what stars tonight. Out in the outback you see them all. Even that one that looks like a guh.
